full_details: The morning was Navarre, as the book stands. At Blackfriars Richard Field sold you a quire of Rochelle paper at the trade price. He told you the Lambeth news. Nine articles. Some chosen before the world was made, and some not. A man cannot move himself from one list to the other. You answered with measure twice and cut once, and you asked the price of crown paper. He was not deceived, and he named no price. You paid fourpence halfpenny. You thought, on the way, of God locked into nine clauses like a tenant into a lease, and of a weaver who could not keep a sentence in order. You wrote none of that. The thought was at the lodging. The afternoon was Navarre. Kemp's tally stayed open. At supper the loaf was two fingers short, and a penny. Verbeke gave you the shuttle, the beam, the reed, the thrum, and the bottom. He tied the weaver's knot twice and made you tie it. He said three words of his own tongue, for bread, for thread, and for good evening. You did not write the spellings. You wrote "bottom" under the board. Mistress Ansell called the tradesmen a satire upon players and approved it, and she called the fairies popery. Alse asked if the weaver is in it. You said he wants to be all of it. It is not a play yet.
one_sentence: You bought a quire at fourpence halfpenny, heard nine articles, and learned the word bottom at supper.
title: A quire, and the word bottom
